* '''Original''' (this page): PC card image of 7 August 2025<ref name="ht-yw-0">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/7821822/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual25-Light/large/youwillgotothedagobahsystem.gif youwillgotothedagobahsystem.gif], commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/7821822 7821822] (7 August 2025).</ref>, no errata mark. [Immune to Sense.] STARTING: If your [Dagobah] objective on table, deploy two Effects (except Wokling) that deploy for free and are always immune to Alter. Place Interrupt in hand.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[You Will Go To The Dagobah System (V) (Errata)]]): PC card image of 10 August 2025<ref name="ht-yw-1">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/3c0adde/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual25-Light/large/youwillgotothedagobahsystem.gif youwillgotothedagobahsystem.gif], commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/3c0adde 3c0adde] (10 August 2025).</ref>, no errata mark. Text: “LOST: Take [Dagobah] Luke into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR Retrieve Anakin's Lightsaber into hand. [Immune to Sense.] STARTING: If your [Dagobah] objective on table, deploy two Effects (except Wokling) that deploy for free and are always immune to Alter. Place Interrupt in hand.”
Versions follow Bill's ruling of 12 November 2026: every visible change on a PC card image is a version (the PC's own E marks count only its announced errata).
